turns.teacher: Good morning children! Today we will do subtraction with our bundles and sticks. Fifty two minus twenty seven. Everybody, try it in your notebook.
turns.label: other

turns.teacher: Arjoon, you wrote 35. Can you tell me how you got it? Start from the ones.
turns.label: ask_to_explain

turns.teacher: Okay, so you said 2 is small, so you took one ten and made it 12, then 12 minus 7 is 5. Very good, that part is correct. Now, after you took that ten, how many tens are left in fifty two?
turns.label: targeted_question

turns.teacher: Come, Arjun, take these five bundles and two sticks. That is fifty two. Now open one bundle for the ones. Count, how many bundles are still tied?
turns.label: concrete_materials

turns.teacher: Yes, only four bundles! So in the tens column it is four minus two, not five minus two. What do you get now?
turns.label: targeted_question

turns.teacher: Very nice, Arjun. You remembered the opened bundle is gone from the tens. That is the main thing today.
turns.label: specific_praise

turns.teacher: Sanaa, I saw you got 25 also. Can you softly tell us what you did with the tens?
turns.label: invite_quiet_child

turns.teacher: Thumbs up if you agree the answer is twenty five. Rabi, Mina, show me your thumbs.
turns.label: check_whole_class

turns.teacher: Now one more. Sixty one minus thirty four. Arjun, this time keep your bundles next to you and cross out the ten you open.
turns.label: new_sum
